CustomField.description: Business days (Mon-Fri) the request has been at its current approval step, counted from Step Reached At to today. Used by the Discount_Request_SLA_Reminder flow (KAN-43). Public holidays are not excluded.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Step_Reached_At__c), NULL, (5 * FLOOR((TODAY() - DATE(1900, 1, 8)) / 7) + MIN(5, MOD(TODAY() - DATE(1900, 1, 8), 7))) - (5 * FLOOR((DATEVALUE(Step_Reached_At__c) - DATE(1900, 1, 8)) / 7) + MIN(5, MOD(DATEVALUE(Step_Reached_At__c) - DATE(1900, 1, 8), 7))) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Working days this request has waited at its current approval step.
CustomField.label: Business Days At Step
